# Journal of Sports Science and Medicine

> An open-access, peer-reviewed academic journal publishing cutting-edge research in sports science, exercise physiology, and sports medicine.

JSSM is a quarterly electronic journal indexed in major databases including MEDLINE, SCOPUS, and PubMed. The journal operates under the Budapest Open Access Initiative (BOAI) principles, making all peer-reviewed research freely available to the global scientific community.

## Key Topics

- Open-Access Publishing
- Peer Review Process
- Sports Science Research
- Sports Medicine
- Exercise Sciences
- Impact Factor
